# Gamified Lives
> Self-improvement RPG for iOS that turns goals, habits and daily tasks into quests, with a hero you build, weekly bosses tied to real tasks, and an AI coach that calls when you go quiet.

## About
Gamified Lives gamifies self-improvement across six life domains (Health, Sleep, Wealth, Mind, Growth, Recovery). Users build a hero from presets (hair, eyes, brows, and any skin, hair or eye color), complete real-world tasks, earn XP and coins, level up through 30 named ranks, and dress their hero with 250+ cosmetics and a furnishable room. It is forgiveness-first: missing a day never takes anything away, and the Phoenix Bonus pays double XP for coming back within 24 hours. Every week the user picks a boss for the life area they are pushing; every completed task damages it, verified tasks crit, and a missed day only lets the boss heal a little. Proof is optional but available: photo verification, timers, HealthKit auto-verification.

## What Makes It Different
- Forgiveness-first scoring: Time Played instead of a streak, Phoenix Bonus for comebacks, a Resilience Score that rewards recovery
- A hero you build yourself (no photo upload) and grow with gear earned by real tasks
- Weekly bosses per life domain, damaged only by real completions
- Six life domains in one app, each a levelable skill with its own tracking and AI tool
- An AI coach that gives a real voice call when you go quiet, plus text coaching and a weekly cross-domain report
- Squads: private accountability groups, "Find me a squad" auto-matching, communities, leaderboards
- A seven-day Oath signed with your finger during onboarding, with a title for keeping it

## Key Features
- Goals, habits and daily tasks in a 3-tier quest hierarchy; goals auto-progress from logged data
- Avatar Builder, wardrobe (250+ items), furnishable room, titles, frames, monthly pass, prestige
- Weekly boss fights with loot (coins + rare cosmetics)
- Photo, timer and HealthKit verification
- Adaptive Difficulty Engine (5 zones)
- Resilience Score (0-100) and Phoenix Bonus
- AI coach chat, voice calls, weekly report, daily personal quest, domain AI tools (Premium)
- Squads, communities, friends, in-app mailbox
- Smart import from Habitica, Finch and Streaks

## Category
Health & Fitness, Lifestyle, Self-Improvement, Habit Tracking, Gamification

## Pricing
Free with optional Premium ($9.99/month or $75.99/year, 7-day free trial). Free includes all tasks, habits, goals, all six domains, tracking, the hero and common cosmetics, and squads. Premium adds the AI coach (chat and calls), the weekly report, every domain's AI tool, rare and legendary cosmetics, and higher photo-verification limits.

## Age rating
13+. Users must be 13 or older.

## Competitors and Alternatives
Habitica (punishes misses with HP damage; dated UI), Finch (pet-based wellness without RPG depth or verification), Levla (habit RPG without AI coaching or real-world verification), Fabulous (routines without gamification), Streaks (minimalist, no RPG). Gamified Lives is the one that rewards the comeback, verifies real work, covers all six life areas, and has a coach that calls.
